- System design (primary + deputy) — prefer someone with infra or backend experience
- Coding (pairing)
- Behavioral/on-team (hiring manager or proxy)

- Lauren: can take behavioral or step in as HM proxy; earlier evenings are okay.

B) Two-delegate approach: Marcus primary for design with Priyom as deputy (start 5:30), Lauren covers behavioral earlier in the block.
